Container.Name: spaces-postgres
Container.Overview:
Postgres 17 with pgvector for Spaces — pgvector/pgvector:pg17 carries pgvector 0.8.x, and Spaces' migrations need 0.8 or newer; a plain postgres image fails at the first migration. Spaces creates its schema on its own first start; nothing to run here.
The Postgres data path is one half of a Spaces backup; the other half is the spaces container's Data path with secret.key. Lose `./data/secret.key` and every stored credential is unrecoverable. (On Unraid, ./data is the spaces container's Data path.) Back both up together.

Config.Name: Postgres port
Config.Description: The host port the spaces container's DATABASE_URL names.

Config.Name: Postgres data
Config.Description: The database. Back it up with the spaces container's Data path.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Choose one; it goes into the spaces container's DATABASE_URL.
